bible.title: Two Shrines, One Garter
bible.kernel: A hiring priest asks the company to recover a contested garter relic and return it to their shrine.

cast.name: Gille
cast.who: a middling priest at a small riverside shrine who keeps careful pledges and asks favors plainly.
cast.want: to recover the garter relic and have it delivered into the hiring shrine's custody

cast.name: Caranya
cast.who: an elf born in the Western Forests who left formal orders and tends the old groves alone.
cast.want: to keep the garter on her and to guard the sealed vault beneath the grove

cast.name: Vladolfr
cast.who: a gaunt gravedigger turned practitioner who claims the buried vault and raises its defenders.
cast.want: to hold the Hearthwyd Vault and its contents against any claimant

bible.situation: Two small shrines both claim a jeweled garter relic. The hiring shrine says the relic belongs in their care and hires the company to fetch it. The rival shrine blames thieves and says only a torn piece was left. The garter itself is on an elf in the old-growth who also serves as the ward for a buried vault that holds a trove. A necromancer claims the vault and defends it with grave-sorcery.
bible.goal: Recover the garter relic claimed by the hiring shrine and return it into that shrine's custody.
arc: Go to the hiring shrine Gille named to take the shrine's claim and ask for proof and leads → yields: a pledged token and a witness who says the rival only holds a torn strip and that a lone elf took the garter into Thornmother Grove.

Follow the witness into Thornmother Grove to find the elf and press for the garter → yields: Caranya herself, wearing the garter and refusing to hand it over, and her warning that Vladolfr holds the sealed Hearthwyd Vault beneath the grove.
Force entry at Hearthwyd Vault where Vladolfr defends the ground, beat or outwit him, use Caranya to lift the ward, and return the garter and the vault's trove to Gille at Rivenwell Shrine.
tensions: Two rival shrines both press claim and may inflame pilgrims.
Caranya refuses to be handed over and will trade only on her terms.
Vladolfr defends the vault with raised corpses and bitter bargains.
openDirections: If the retrieval drags, the rival shrine may send armed petitioners and a public trial will force harsher choices.
bible.stakeIfLost: If the company fails, the hiring shrine will lose the garter relic and so fail to open the buried vault that holds its pledged trove of pilgrim offerings.
bible.arrival: came in the night and would not wait for morning · brought no one with them

shipped.title: Take the shrine's claim and ask for leads
shipped.situation: A middling priest arrived in the night and would not wait for morning, Gille. He asked the fort for soldiers to fetch a relic. He says the hiring shrine will lose the garter relic and so fail to open the buried vault that holds its pledged trove of pilgrim offerings if this fails. The errand is to go to the hiring shrine Gille named, take the shrine's claim and ask for proof and any leads, the pay is honest coin, and any small spoils besides. A necromancer means to hold the Hearthwyd Vault and its contents against any claimant. Gille laughs in the wrong place while he speaks.
shipped.job: Go to the hiring shrine Gille named to take the shrine's claim and ask for proof and leads
